gamerule.physicsbruhh.physical_goo: Honey and slime behave like goo
gamerule.physicsbruhh.physical_goo.descr: Placed or piston-moved honey and slime blocks melt, wobble and stretch instead of staying rigid blocks. Turn off to keep vanilla contraptions working.
